name: PeekXR
summary:
# View your iPhone or iPad in Meta Quest

PeekXR streams your iPhone or iPad screen over local Wi-Fi to a native, resizable window on Meta Quest.

## Pair your devices

Scan the short-lived QR code or enter the four-digit pairing code shown on your iPhone or iPad. Before sharing starts, compare the matching six-digit security number on both devices.

## Features

- View screens in portrait or landscape.
- Keep a native 2D window nearby in Meta Quest.
- Hear supported app audio when screen sharing permits it
